mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id WHERE e.student_id=s.id AND e.active=1 AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND m.status='0' AND m.role_id=20)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{studentId} AND role_id=10 AND status='0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT notice_version FROM self_efficacy_notice_ack WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO self_efficacy_notice_ack(student_id,notice_version) VALUES(#{studentId},#{version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notice_version=VALUES(notice_version),accepted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id,m.nick_name AS display_name,m.user_name AS username FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id WHERE e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.role_id=20 AND m.status='0' ORDER BY m.id
SELECT s.id,s.nick_name AS display_name,s.user_name AS username FROM sys_user s WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user s WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND
SELECT FROM self_efficacy_entry r WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY r.assessment_date DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM self_efficacy_entry r JOIN self_efficacy_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY r.assessment_date DESC,r.id DESC

SELECT FROM self_efficacy_entry r JOIN self_efficacy_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} AND r.assessment_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY r.assessment_date,r.id

SELECT FROM self_efficacy_entry r JOIN self_efficacy_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=r.student_id WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND ORDER BY r.assessment_date DESC,r.id DESC

SELECT FROM self_efficacy_entry r JOIN self_efficacy_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=r.student_id WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND AND r.assessment_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY r.assessment_date,r.id
